title: Pilot
subtitle: What I'm doing here
html:
We are reborn in each moment.

Cell turnover, synaptogenesis, and perpetual interaction with the world beyond the boundary of our skin ensure that we’re never the same person twice. Everchanging, we are all, in a sense, forever young.

It’s the job of a young person to grapple with interesting ideas, develop valuable skills, and make themselves useful. A Young Person’s Guide to the Galaxy is my effort to chronicle my journey of doing just that.

What am I grappling with? What am I learning? How do I (or how do I hope to) make myself useful?

This blog will answer those questions and many more.

Welcome to A Young Person’s Guide to the Galaxy…
